name: APT-SIM-CASE-TEMPLATE
title: Incident Case: Synthetic Multi-Stage APT Intrusion Investigation (Candidate Template)
description:
Comprehensive SOC investigation case template modeled for TheHive 5. Represents the multi-stage APT training scenario progressing across Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Lateral Movement, and Exfiltration.

DISCLAIMER: This is a candidate case template generated offline. It has not been imported into a live TheHive instance.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Initial Access Analysis (T1566.001)
tasks.description: Inspect email gateway logs and user mailbox on LAB-WIN01. Extract attachment invoice_march2026.docm and identify macro execution behavior spawning cmd.exe or powershell.exe.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Execution & Script Block Analysis (T1059.001)
tasks.description: Analyze Windows Event ID 4688 and PowerShell ScriptBlock Event ID 4104 on LAB-WIN01. Deobfuscate base64 payload passed via -EncodedCommand argument.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Persistence Audit (T1053.005)
tasks.description: Review Task Scheduler events (Task ID 106/140, Event 4698). Verify creation of scheduled task 'WindowsUpdateCheck' executing updater.ps1 as SYSTEM.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Privilege Escalation & Token Verification (T1078 / T1134)
tasks.description: Review Windows Security Event 4672 on LAB-WIN01. Confirm assignment of SeDebugPrivilege to the non-admin student user context via consent.exe.

tasks.title: Task 5 - Lateral Movement & Remote WMI Trace (T1021.002 / T1047)
tasks.description: Correlate Network Logon (Event 4624 Type 3) on LAB-SRV01 from source LAB-WIN01 (192.0.2.50). Identify WMI process call create invoked via wmiprvse.exe.

tasks.title: Task 6 - Exfiltration & DNS Tunneling Analysis (T1071.004)
tasks.description: Inspect Sysmon Event ID 22 and network DNS query logs. Measure query length and entropy for outbound requests to exfil.training.lab.

tasks.title: Task 7 - Containment, Eradication & Recovery (NIST SP 800-61r2)
tasks.description: Formulate containment actions: host network isolation for LAB-WIN01 and LAB-SRV01, scheduled task deletion, domain DNS sinkholing, and password resets.
